frozen_location.selection: training-selected five-block blind Sacramento set refinement

limitations: candidate selection used these RF trajectories, so residual comparisons are descriptive and not identity validation
the frozen receiver location was selected from the same five-block training evidence
candidate weights are uncalibrated composite weights, not correctness probabilities
chronological heldout scores forecast the tail; five-block heldout scores interpolate within the same time span
constant frequency offsets remove absolute frequency and leave only trajectory shape
nominal causal TLEs are used without orbit correction or transmitter truth

protocol.candidate_set: four first-comparison leader changes with both weights >= 0.9
protocol.frequency_scale: predicted Doppler and residual metrics use the canonical 11.2 GHz analysis carrier, not each channel's native RF
protocol.metrics: ordinary RMS on identical observations under each partition mask
protocol.nuisance: one candidate-specific constant fitted from each evaluated partition's training mask
protocol.orbit: exact nominal causal TLE propagation at each observation time

repeated_e201_shape_diagnostic.interpretation: descriptive gross observed-trajectory comparison on common support; dominated by common Doppler shape, not a residual-independence test, and the different channel paths are not paired-receiver evidence
